rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the spring-back property and for flexibility in handling situations.

example.english: This rubber band has a lot of elasticity; even after being stretched, it shrinks back.
example.traditional: 呢條橡筋好有彈性，拉長咗都縮得返。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 zoeng6 gan1 hou2 jau5 daan6 sing3 laai1 coeng4 zo2 dou1 suk1 dak1 faan1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a person’s or organization’s ability to adapt to changing circumstances.

example.english: This company’s elasticity in adapting to market changes is impressive.
example.traditional: 呢間公司面對市場轉變嘅適應力好強。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 gung1 si1 min6 deoi3 si5 coeng4 zyun2 bin3 ge3 sik1 jing3 lik6 hou2 koeng4
